verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's Incentives, remuneration and benefits page explicitly covers EMI and company share option plans plus growth shares, and the firm has offices in Germany and India, supporting founder equity design across jurisdictions. However, the evidence does not explicitly mention German VSOP/ESOP structures or Indian ESOPs by name — only UK EMI and generic 'company share option plans' are documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of German VSOP/ESOP schemes, explicit mention of Indian ESOP advisory, and any dedicated cross-border equity-plan design page.
